goal: Decide whether garbage collection may evict a blob from a kappa-distribution registry, so storage is reclaimed without losing anything a tag, pin, finalizer or upload still needs.

app.name: gc-eviction
app.title: GC eviction
app.purpose: Decide, as a DMN decision table with hit policy FIRST, whether a sweep retains or evicts a blob, from whether a tag reaches it, the state of its pin, any finalizer on it and whether an upload session protects it.
limits: It does not walk edges; it decides from what the sweep's snapshot found reaching the blob.
Snapshot isolation between concurrent pins and the sweep is the registry's, per spec 9.4.

fields.name: tag
fields.means: whether a tag binding reaches the blob in the sweep snapshot

fields.name: pin
fields.means: the blob's pin: TTL 0, an unexpired TTL, an expired TTL, or no pin

fields.name: finalizer
fields.means: a finalizer pin and whether its controller released it

fields.name: upload
fields.means: whether an open upload session pin protects the content

meanings.evict: nothing protects the blob, so the sweep may reclaim it

rules.why: KAPPA_DISTRIBUTION_SPEC_v2.md 3.8: a finalizer pin blocks GC until the named controller releases it
3.8: an upload session pin protects partially-uploaded content
content-before-tag: a tag binding never points at evicted content
3.8: TTL 0 is permanent until explicitly superseded
3.8: a pin protects its blob until its TTL expires

app.otherwiseWhy: nothing reaches or protects the blob, so the sweep reclaims it

properties.why: an outstanding finalizer always blocks eviction
a tagged blob is never evicted
an untagged blob whose pin expired is always reclaimed

stakeholders.name: Registry operator
stakeholders.text: Runs the registry day to day and needs storage reclaimed without ever losing content a tag, pin, finalizer or upload still needs.

stakeholders.name: Business owner
stakeholders.text: Pays for storage and answers for data loss, and needs both kept down without reading the protocol.

concerns.name: Nothing needed is evicted
concerns.text: A sweep reclaims only blobs no tag, live pin, finalizer or upload protects.
